title: 10 Best Dal Bhat in Kathmandu
description: The best dal bhat restaurants in Kathmandu — curated from Reddit. Thakali kitchens, heritage restaurants, royal dining experiences and budget spots.

picks.name: Mantra Thakali Restaurant
picks.verdict: Reddit consensus pick for best dal bhat — authentic Thakali seasoning with unlimited refills.

picks.name: Thakkhola Thakali Cuisine
picks.verdict: Budget king — no-frills Thakali with authentic flavors at the lowest price.

picks.name: Thakali Bhanchha Ghar
picks.verdict: Best in Thamel with live cultural performances every evening.

picks.name: Tukuche Thakali Kitchen
picks.verdict: Tukuche village flavors with the signature Prumuchhop chili powder.

picks.name: Thasang Authentic Thakali Kitchen
picks.verdict: Unlimited refill champion with genuinely generous portions.

picks.name: Bhojan Griha
picks.verdict: Former palace with four-course Nepali set menu and live cultural show.

picks.name: Krishnarpan at Dwarika's
picks.verdict: 6 to 22-course Nepali tasting menu in a heritage palace hotel.

picks.name: Nepali Chulo
picks.verdict: Restored palace with brass utensils, Newari options, and cultural performances.

picks.name: Mustang Restaurant and Thakali Kitchen
picks.verdict: Hidden gem with early morning dal bhat from 6:30 AM.

picks.name: Baithak Restaurant
picks.verdict: Victorian palace setting with silver utensils and cultural show.
